weekly_objective: Protect recovery through the back half of the week by trimming aerobic volume slightly while avoiding any new intensity, given declining readiness on top of already-deep chronic fatigue.
coach_says: Your TSB barely moved but readiness dropped 16 points — that's your body flagging that Tuesday's double session hasn't been fully absorbed yet, even though HRV and sleep still look decent. We're trimming Friday and Saturday's ride durations to take some load off while keeping the weekend long ride intact rather than pulling it entirely, and leaving both gym sessions light as originally planned.

days.details: 45 min gentle flow focused on hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and lower back. Slow, breath-led pace, no strain. Purpose: prime the body for tomorrow's big double session, not to add load. Weather is windy/overcast with rain risk, so keep this indoors.

days.session: AM Hills Ride + PM Hard MTB Group Ride
days.details:
AM - Hills Road Ride: 75 min | Zone 4 threshold hill work | 5-6 x 5 min hill climbs at threshold effort (RPE 7-8), easy spin-down recovery between efforts, 15 min easy warm-up/cool-down. Clear skies - ride outdoor.

PM - Hard MTB Group Ride: 90 min | Committed, non-negotiable group pace | Technical trail terrain with repeated high-intensity surges (RPE 7-9), treat as your anaerobic/VO2 stimulus for the week. Fuel and hydrate well between AM and PM sessions given the size of this day.

40 min | Zone 1-2, flat terrain, fully conversational pace | No intervals, no structure — the goal is blood flow and leg turnover to flush yesterday's double session. Clear skies, ride outdoor. Mandatory easy day — do not push pace regardless of how legs feel.

Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min general warm-up, mobility work for hips and shoulders
Goblet Squat 3 x 10 (light-moderate load)
Bulgarian Split Squat 3 x 8 each leg
Lat Pulldown 3 x 10-12
Plank 3 x 45sec
Standing Calf Raise 3 x 12 each side
Rest: 60 sec between sets

75 min | Zone 2 steady aerobic endurance | Rolling terrain, RPE 4-5, no intervals — smooth, sustained aerobic riding only. Duration trimmed from original plan given lower readiness this week; ideal cool, dry conditions with light winds, good outdoor window. Fuel every 45 min.

115 min | Zone 2 long ride, weekend | Steady, conversational pace throughout (RPE 4-5), no hard efforts. Trimmed from 150 min to protect recovery while still delivering the weekend aerobic stimulus. Dry, light winds (~10 km/h) — good outdoor conditions. Practice race-day nutrition/hydration pacing; resist pushing climbs hard.

Workout B:
Warm-up: 5 min general warm-up, dynamic mobility
Deadlift 3 x 8 (light-moderate load)
Walking Lunge 3 x 10 each leg
Seated Cable Row 3 x 10-12
Side Plank 3 x 30sec each side
Hip Thrust 3 x 12 (light load)
Rest: 60 sec between sets
